name: Shoestring Fern
desc: Shoestring Fern (Vittaria lineata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 21 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Vittaria lineata, also known by its common name shoestring fern is a species of fern from the genus Vittaria. It grows epiphytically in wet, new-world tropics and subtropics as far north as Florida.
